Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer specifies "Leirion" as the first name of the mayor. This refers to Leirion Gaylor Baird, the mayor of Lincoln, Nebraska. Lincoln is the capital of Nebraska, home to the University of Nebraska (a former full member of the Big 12 Conference), and Leirion Gaylor Baird attended Yale University, which was also attended by several U.S. presidents. 

The Predicted Answer states "Kate Gallego" (mayor of Phoenix). Phoenix is the capital of Arizona and is home to Arizona State University, which only joined the Big 12 in 2024 and was not a former or outgoing full member. Furthermore, while Kate Gallego attended Harvard (attended by U.S. presidents), the Predicted Answer provides a different first name and city than the Ground Truth Answer.

Therefore, the vital facts and meaning of the Ground Truth Answer ("Leirion") are not present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
